en.headline: Government reviews dog control rules after attacks, aims to amend law next year
en.dek: Secretary for Environment and Ecology Tse Chin-wan said the review of current regulations will go to the Legislative Council by year-end, with completion of amendments targeted for next year.
body: The government is reviewing existing regulations on dog control following recent incidents in which dogs attacked people and animals, Secretary for Environment and Ecology Tse Chin-wan said on Wednesday.

In a written reply to a legislator’s question, Tse said the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department and the police were investigating the causes of the incidents and had implemented enforcement and control measures. The review of the regulations would be put to the Legislative Council by the end of this year, with the aim of completing legislative amendments next year.

Tse said there was a general view in the community that current penalties for abandoning animals and for failing to control dogs properly were not sufficiently deterrent, and the government would study increasing those penalties. Officials were also collecting views on whether the definitions of fighting dogs and known dangerous dogs needed updating, drawing on practices in other places and applying a risk-based approach.

On enforcement, the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department had analysed recent attack cases on a risk basis and would prioritise high-risk locations that had seen incidents or had more stray dogs for stepped-up patrols and the capture of unmanaged dogs. Keepers found not controlling their dogs properly would face firm enforcement.

Tse clarified that there was no arrangement under current law for proxy registration of dog microchips, and that any registered keeper must fulfil all legal responsibilities as a dog owner. Abandoning or allowing dogs to roam unsupervised in public places was illegal.

zh.headline: 政府全面檢視管束狗隻法規 爭取明年內完成修例
zh.dek: 環境及生態局局長謝展寰表示，現行法規檢視將於今年年底諮詢立法會，並以明年內完成修例為目標。
body: 環境及生態局局長謝展寰周三表示，早前發生狗隻襲擊人畜事件後，政府正全面檢視現行管束狗隻的法規。
謝展寰書面回覆立法會議員質詢時說，漁護署及警方正調查事故成因，並已採取相應執法及管控措施。有關法規檢視將於今年年底提交立法會，並爭取明年內完成修例。
他指出，社會普遍認為現行針對棄掉動物及沒有妥善管束狗隻的罰則阻嚇力不足，政府會研究加重相關罰則。當局亦正收集意見，檢視是否需要更新「格鬥狗隻」及「已知危險狗隻」的定義，並參考其他地方經驗，按風險為本原則定出方案。
在執法方面，漁護署已按風險為本原則分析近期襲擊個案，並會優先在曾發生事故或流浪狗較多的高風險地點加強巡查及捕捉無人看管狗隻。如發現畜養人未有妥善控制狗隻，署方會嚴正執法。
謝展寰澄清，現行法例並無「代登記狗隻晶片」安排，登記狗主必須承擔所有法律規定的畜養人責任。棄掉或放任狗隻於公眾地方遊蕩均屬違法。
